entities.name: Han Gyong-si
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Han Gyong-si is a North Korean weightlifter. He competed at the 1976 Summer Olympics and the 1980 Summer Olympics. At the 1980 Summer Olympics, he won the bronze medal in the flyweight event.
